note: Last untested zero-cost knob. Zero-cost levers have been the best value in this campaign -- warmup alone was -0.184 -- and cooldown is warmup's counterpart at the other end of the WSD schedule. It has sat at the inherited 0.15 for all 27 arms and has never been varied. 0.30 doubles the anneal: at 142 steps that is 42 cooldown steps after 14 warmup, leaving 86 at peak LR. Costs nothing in throughput, so any gain is pure iso-compute gain.
